- **Dependencies:** _None_
- **Web Binding:** yes
- **Owned Tables:** `audit_log`, `audit_activity`
- **Published Events:** _None_

| ---------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
